name: profile-dropdown
title: Profile Dropdown
description: An account menu that grows out of its own trigger, with status, theme, links, account switching and a hold-to-confirm sign out.

props.name: accounts
props.description: Accounts to switch between: id, name, email, initials, plan.

props.name: defaultAccountId
props.description: Id of the account shown first. Defaults to the first account.

props.name: onAccountChange
props.description: Called when the user picks another account.

props.name: onAddAccount
props.description: Called when the user picks Add account.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu entries between the settings rows and Switch account.

props.name: theme
props.description: Controlled theme. Leave it out to keep the choice in local state.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status. Leave it out to keep the choice in local state.

props.name: onSignOut
props.description: Called once Sign out has been held for holdDuration.

props.name: holdDuration
props.description: Milliseconds Sign out must be held.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
